Hi Marta / Kevin —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps so we can get the right hosting/migration path locked in: 

Call highlights
- Workload split: near-real-time customer chat + search (low-latency, user-facing) and large nightly batch jobs (model retraining/feature extraction).
- Regulatory note: a subset of telemetry and some PII must remain in a controlled VPC for EU/US-regulated lines of business.
- Current stack: you’re using MegaAI’s hosted API for most features and an on-prem GPU cluster for heavy batch jobs.

Preliminary hosting alignment
- Hosted API (fastest to production) — good for customer chat but may require VPC peering or private routing for regulated data.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) — gives predictable latency & throughput, easier to keep keys in your KMS; recommended if low-latency production traffic is large.
- Private (VPC / on-prem) — necessary for fully isolated regulatory workloads and offline batch processing.

Migration considerations we should confirm
- Tokenization parity & model artifacts: will you require identical tokenizer/model weights or are approximations OK for embeddings?
- KV cache transfer: warmup strategies for chat sessions coming off MegaAI vs self-hosted caches.
- Auth & SSO + KMS: ability to bring your KMS and/or SAML/IdP integration timeline.

Proposed next steps (can we do these by next week?)
1) You share the filled security questionnaire + network diagram (helps us size Private option). (I’ve attached a short checklist and hosting comparison.)
2) 30-min technical deep-dive with your infra lead (to validate VPC peering / firewall rules).
3) Rough cost comparison for: Dedicated 8-GPU pool vs hosted + burst.

If that works I’ll coordinate a time and loop in Marissa and Karthik to scope the SOW and security answers.

Thanks — Ben

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side after regrouping: 
- Workloads: customer chat (latency-sensitive) must be sub-200ms p95. Search/embedding queries are slightly more tolerant. Batch retraining & feature extraction must stay on our private network for IP retention.
- Migration sources: we currently call MegaAI’s API for most features and maintain a small in-house GPU cluster (4x A100) for offline jobs. We want a migration that minimizes user-facing diffs — tokenization parity matters for chat history continuity.
- Security: attached is a partially-completed SOC2 questionnaire and our high-level network diagram. We will need KMS integration and support for dedicated audit logs.

For next steps: please send the hosting comparison & the migration checklist you referenced. We’re available for the 30-min technical deep-dive next Tue 10am PT. Also — can you provide a ballpark for Dedicated (8x A100 equiv) vs hosted per-month cost? That will help us prep procurement.

Quick internal note — forwarding Marta’s reply. Key asks: SOC2 evidence, network diagram received, they need a sub-200ms p95 for chat, tokenization parity needed, and procurement wants a ballpark for Dedicated (8 GPU) vs hosted. They have a 4x A100 on-prem cluster for batch; we should validate an approach that keeps batch on Private while moving real-time to Dedicated or Hosted with private routing.

Proposed approach (sketch):
- Short term (0–3 weeks): Hosted API behind private egress + tokenization parity tests. Use prefix caching to minimize warmup.
- Mid term (1–3 months): Evaluate Dedicated 8-GPU pool with customer KMS + reserved throughput; run cost model vs hosted at current projected QPS.
- Long term (3–6 months): Private VPC connectors for batch jobs and a data-mirroring plan for model training artifacts.

Ask Marissa/Karthik: can you review the attached hybrid architecture and confirm whether our private connector supports their firewall pattern? If yes, I’ll propose Tue 10am PT as the tech dive and draft a rough cost comparison.

— Ben
